title: F6 proponent: YAR superscript letters as Caesar shifts {Y=24, A=0, R=17}
hypothesis_summary: Anomaly A5 (Elonka 2002 rubbings, undiscussed by Sanborn): three letters Y-A-R in the cipher-side line 15 are physically raised. With A=0 numbering, Y=24, A=0, R=17. The proponent reading interprets these as Caesar shift values to compose with the disclosed-crib keyword pool — in particular Y=24 as a primary near-zero shift (equivalent to -2) and R=17 as a secondary shift. Excludes A=0 (zero shift is degenerate at the Caesar layer).

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Anomaly A5: superscript YAR on cipher-side line 15. Y=24, A=0, R=17 (A=0 numbering). Elonka 2002 rubbings.

composition_templates.rationale: Caesar shift from YAR letters, single-layer.
LESSON-019 numeric-Caesar + route + columnar with YAR shift values.

constraints: Shifts restricted to {17, 24} (A=0 of YAR excluded as degenerate).
caveats: A5 was downgraded to Tier-2 in the project anomaly registry (2026-04-03 audit) — not eliminated, but the cipher-significance interpretation is weak. Confidence reflects this.
